name: GigaVoxels
definition: A dynamic sparse octree approach for efficient and detailed voxel rendering that achieves real-time to interactive rates on volumes exceeding GPU memory capacities by using ray-guided streaming. The volume is only used at the resolution needed to produce the final image, providing memory/speed gains and inherent anti-aliasing.
summary: GigaVoxels is a dynamic sparse octree method that renders billions of voxels in real-time by streaming only necessary data based on ray-guided adaptive resolution.
